brand.name: Clelia & Co. Design Studio
brand.vibe: High-end jewelry e-commerce, editorial storytelling, quiet luxury, precision, and elegance.

typography.pairing_strategy: Elegant Serif Headings + Clean Geometric Body. High contrast in weights (e.g., Light headers, Regular body).

layouts.marketing_pages: Minimal, editorial layout. High white-space. Overlapping sections, asymmetrical grids. Large, high-res imagery.
layouts.dashboard_pages: Structured Bento grid, high density but retaining luxury feel. Champagne borders, white surface on ivory background. Cards with 1px border-champagne/40.
layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing: p-6 to p-32. Containers must have internal padding. Use gap-8 to gap-16 for e-commerce grids.

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.cards: Flat background (white), 1px subtle champagne border, soft ambient shadow. Gold-foil micro-details (subtle linear gradients in borders or small accents).
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-ivory/80 with 1px bottom border of champagne/20.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows. e.g. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(28,28,28,0.06)]

motion.animations: Subtle and precise. Slow fades, smooth transforms on hover (-translate-y-1). Staggered entrances for product grids.
motion.transitions: transition-colors transition-transform duration-500 ease-out. Parallax effects on hero images.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px border. Primary button: bg-plum text-ivory hover:bg-plum/90. Secondary button: transparent border-champagne text-ink hover:bg-champagne/10.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn based. Minimalist inputs with bottom border only, or subtle rounded rectangles. Focus state: ring-1 ring-champagne.
components.navigation: Sticky nav, minimal links, centered logo. Transparent to glassmorphism on scroll.
components.design_studio_flow: Multi-step wizard with clear progress indicator. Uses queued states with elegant loaders (e.g. spinning gold ring or slow pulsating logo) during AI generation.
components.3d_preview: Use react-three-fiber for the 3D/AR preview surface of the jewelry.

specific_functionalities_guidelines.auth: Separate customer and staff logins. Staff requires TOTP 2FA. Design these forms with elegance—centered forms inside a champagne-bordered white card on an ivory background.
specific_functionalities_guidelines.ai_design_studio: Include states for GPT Image 1 and Gemini Nano Banana selection. Treat the generation state as a premium experience, not just a technical loading bar. Display queued concept generation state.
specific_functionalities_guidelines.quote_and_checkout: Checkout is 'quote request' only initially. Keep Razorpay and Stripe components in code but disabled/hidden.
specific_functionalities_guidelines.manager_dashboard: Internal print-file panel MUST be visually distinct (maybe a slight structural grey tint) to denote security. Pricing, analytics, and audit pages should use Shadcn charts with the luxury color palette.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: No dark mode. Implement strict light mode using the ivory background.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns to preserve legibility.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="quote-request-button"`).
Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) with 'thin' or 'light' weight for an elegant look.
Do not center-align body text paragraphs; use left-alignment for readability, even in elegant layouts.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients; use solid colors and subtle textures.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install `@phosphor-icons/react` for icons. Ensure Tailwind is configured with the custom colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.components_to_use: Leverage shadcn/ui for dropdowns, tabs, tables (for staff dashboard), and dialogs. Use `sonner` for toast notifications.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Overwrite the default App.css center alignment. Add standard CSS reset and custom scrollbar styling in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure `data-testid` is added to all actionable elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.3d_libraries: Install `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei` for the 3D/AR preview surface.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
